data.name: 伴星VR
data.detailed_description:
Banxing VR

Banxing VR is a professional immersive virtual reality interactive application fully optimized for Windows PC VR devices.

Core Experience

  • Realistic virtual scene rendering with high-precision environmental details

  • Smooth 6DoF motion tracking, supporting natural hand interactive operation

  • Compatible with all mainstream PC VR headsets, including Meta Quest Link, Valve Index, HTC Vive, Pico PC Streaming

  • Independent built scene logic, bringing you a unique, unduplicated immersive experience

Game Features

  • High-fidelity visual effects: Optimized rendering pipeline to balance picture quality and running frame rate

  • Free interactive mode: Walk, touch, operate all virtual objects in the scene freely

  • Lightweight running demand: Works stably on mid-range VR dedicated computers

  • Exclusive VR-oriented design: All interaction logic and scene layout are developed exclusively for virtual reality experience

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7500 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card
  • VR Support: Pico 4 (PC Streaming)、Meta Quest 2

  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
